events.text: {"verdict":"proceed","decision":"Continue T-470 without Adi. (1) Load the 219 Tantra answers (revops-os/tests/packs/t470-content/tantra-fields.json, mapped via CARD_BY_ID) plus content-answers.json onto a test attendee with put-answers.mjs. Use a fresh test attendee, not 165, with the Tantra identity and simulator vendors. (2) Re-fetch packs with tests/fetch-packs.mjs. (3) Rerun run.py on t470-content for 2.10 to 2.15, the D3 weekly content loop and the wrap. Use a fresh Sonnet session per prompt. Get Fable reviews, then fix the prompts, guides and day2*.json for any item below 2 on any of the six criteria. Repeat up to 4 rounds per prompt. Any prompt still failing after that becomes its own fix task. (4) Respect the budget.py guard and the 60% window line, and do not raise the caps. If the run is waiting on the window, leave it running and resume on its own. Do not run it in parallel with t469 if that would exceed the window. (5) Log each round in workshop-plan/research/revops-os-test-log.md. (6) When every content prompt scores 2 on all six, commit and push, run deploy-clean.sh --preview review, and move the task to review for Adi and Bharath. Keep Backlinko voice and Metricool, and use the Tantra/Resend newsletter and the Worker blog.
